name: date
description: Display or set date and time

options.name: -d
options.description: Set the kernel's value for daylight saving time

options.name: -f
options.description: Use specified format for input instead of the default [[[mm]dd]HH]MM[[cc]yy][.s…

options.name: -j
options.description: Don't try to set the date

options.name: -n
options.description: Only set time on the current machine, instead of all machines in the local group

options.name: -R
options.description: Use RFC 2822 date and time output format

options.name: -r
options.description: Print the date and time represented by the specified number of seconds since th…

options.name: -t
options.description: Set the system's value for minutes west of GMT

options.name: -u
options.description: Display or set the date in UTC (Coordinated Universal) time

options.name: -v
options.description: Adjust and print (but don't set) the second, minute, hour, month day, week day,…
